mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_journal_entry (id, ledger_book_id, accounting_period_id, instruction_id, journal_sequence, posting_date, entry_type, reversal_of_entry_id, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{ledgerBookId}, #{accountingPeriodId}, #{instructionId}, #{journalSequence}, #{postingDate}, #{entryType}, #{reversalOfEntryId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ledger_book_id, accounting_period_id, instruction_id, journal_sequence, posting_date, entry_type, reversal_of_entry_id, create_time FROM t_journal_entry WHERE instruction_id = #{instructionId}

SELECT e.id journal_entry_id, e.ledger_book_id, e.accounting_period_id, e.journal_sequence, e.posting_date, e.entry_type, e.reversal_of_entry_id, i.id instruction_id, i.instruction_type, i.origin_type, i.source_system, i.source_event_key, i.manual_adjustment_id, m.adjustment_no, CASE WHEN i.origin_type = 'ACCOUNT_POSTING' THEN CAST(i.source_event_key AS UNSIGNED) END account_posting_id, CASE WHEN i.origin_type = 'ACCOUNT_POSTING' THEN i.source_version END account_posting_sequence FROM t_journal_entry e JOIN t_accounting_instruction i ON i.id = e.instruction_id LEFT JOIN t_manual_adjustment m ON m.id = i.manual_adjustment_id WHERE e.id = #{journalEntryId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_journal_entry e LEFT JOIN ( SELECT journal_entry_id, COUNT(*) line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN entry_side = 'DEBIT' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) net FROM t_journal_line GROUP BY journal_entry_id ) s ON s.journal_entry_id = e.id WHERE e.accounting_period_id = #{periodId} AND (s.line_count IS NULL OR s.net <> 0) AND e.ledger_book_id IN #{id}
